done.text: Done so far: the operator's application scope is recorded in ticket 310, the clean lane and its baseline exist, and the envelope, booking authorization, permissionless fold and additive settlement are proposed with a frozen model-only contract.

still-open.text: Still open: the executable law, driver and corpus; the statements, inversions and ledgers; independent review; proofs; the application scripts and builders; connected controls for custody, authorization, refunds, duplicates and permanent retirement; and the hand-off to tickets 299 and 300. Public-chain, release and merge steps stay separate.
